items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Bud Johnson was on the European tour. I took Bernie Peacock... Bud Johnson, Huey Long and John Brown on bass, Jimmy Bryan on piano. MUSICALLY, THEY WERE THE BEST.

ctx.x: Bud Johnson's on this, isn't he?
Bud Johnson was on the European tour. I took Bernie Peacock.
That's where you got Bernie Peacock and Pruitt; two headaches. It's a wonder they didn't get shot by the enemy over there.
